Carmageddon TDR 2000.name: Carmageddon: TDR 2000
Carmageddon TDR 2000.summary: Cancelled port for the Game Boy Color.

Dragon Warrior Monsters 2 - Tara's Adven.name: Dragon Warrior Monsters 2: Tara's Adventure
Dragon Warrior Monsters 2 - Tara's Adven.summary:
Dragon Quest Monsters 2 followed Pokemon's strategy of releasing 2 games with exclusive monsters that would need to be traded between versions to collect them all.

The games were later re-released along with the first Dragon Quest Monsters as a compilation for the PlayStation and the games were later remade for the 3DS, but only in Japan.

Game & Watch Gallery 2.name: Game & Watch Gallery 2
Game & Watch Gallery 2.summary:
Game & Watch Gallery 2 is the sequel to Game & Watch Gallery released in 1997 for the Game Boy, only in Japan. This version is a colorized version released for the Game Boy Color in 1998. The game included six revisions of classic Game & Watch games, one of which is not playable from the beginning and must be unlocked.

This colorized version was never released in Japan, although a prototype was found.

Goraku Ou Tango!.name: Goraku-Ou Tango!
Goraku Ou Tango!.summary: Goraku Ou Tango! is a Puzzle game, developed and published by Mebius, which was released in Japan in 2000.

Hello Kitty to Dear Daniel no Dream Adve.name: Hello Kitty to Dear Daniel no Dream Adventure
Hello Kitty to Dear Daniel no Dream Adve.summary: Platformer game starring Hello Kitty and Dear Daniel.

Jim Henson's Bear in the Big Blue House.name: Jim Henson's Bear in the Big Blue House
Jim Henson's Bear in the Big Blue House.summary: A child-friendly adventure game for Game Boy Color that invites young players to explore the Big Blue House with Bear and friends through simple mini-games and educational activities. With bright sprites, approachable controls, and bite-sized tasks focused on shapes, colors, and memory, it’s designed to teach basic skills while recreating the show’s warm, interactive atmosphere.

Pop'n Pop.name: Pop'n Pop
Pop'n Pop.summary: Pop'n Pop is a puzzle video game released in arcades by Taito in February 1998. It features characters from Taito games Rainbow Islands, Kiki Kaikai, Don Doko Don, and The NewZealand Story.

WDL - World Destruction League - Thunder.name: World Destruction League: Thunder Tanks
WDL - World Destruction League - Thunder.summary: The top-down 2D port of "World Destruction League: Thunder Tanks" for Game Boy Color.
